title: Come & Sea | Stay On 30a – Luxury Beach Homes In 30a Florida
meta_description: Come & Sea — a house in Inlet Beach, Florida. 10 guests · 3 bedrooms · 3.5 bathrooms. Book direct with Stay on 30a.
description_expanded: Welcome to Come & Sea, where relaxed coastal living meets elevated comfort in the heart of Inlet Beach. Thoughtfully designed for families and friends to gather, unwind, and experience everything the Emerald Coast has to offer, this beautiful three-bedroom retreat is the perfect home base for your next 30A getaway.Step inside to a bright, open-concept living space filled with natural light, stylish coastal furnishings, and thoughtful details throughout. The fully stocked kitchen makes everything from easy vacation breakfasts to family dinners and evening cocktails a breeze, while the spacious island and seamless flow into the dining and living areas create the perfect setting for spending time together.With three private ensuite bedrooms, everyone has their own comfortable space to retreat at the end of the day. One of the ensuite bedrooms is a dedicated bunk room, creating a fun and functional space for kids or additional guests while still offering the convenience and privacy of its own bathroom.Step outside into the serene, fully fenced backyard, designed for slow mornings and laid-back evenings under the Florida sky. Enjoy your morning coffee outdoors, fire up the gas grill for dinner, or gather around the fire pit after a day at the beach. The private setting and fenced-in space make the backyard an inviting extension of the home and the perfect place to relax together.Getting around 30A is part of the fun at Come & Sea. Take one of four complimentary adult bikes to nearby beach access, cruise over to Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, or head just 0.4 miles to 30Avenue for shopping, dining, and entertainment. Beach days are made even easier with chairs, umbrellas, a wagon, and coolers provided for your stay.Back at the home, cool off at the nearby community pool before returning to your own coastal retreat. Whether your perfect vacation includes mornings on the sugar-white sand, afternoons exploring by bike, family dinners fresh off the grill, or evenings gathered around the backyard fire pit, Come & Sea offers the comfort, space, and coastal charm you need to relax, reconnect, and make unforgettable memories on 30A.HOME HIGHLIGHTS5 minutes to the GulfCommunity pool4 adult bikes2 dedicated parking spotsGas grillGas fire pitTwo laundry rooms with full washer/dryerBeach gearPrivate backyardFully stocked kitchenSleeper sofaInlet Beach30Avenue .4 milesRosemary & Alys beach are a short bike rideACCOMMODATIONSCome & Sea comfortably accommodates up to 10 people:First Floor:Bedroom 1: Queen, Ensuite BathroomKitchen-Living (featuring a sleeper sofa)-Dining-Half BathroomSecond Floor:Bedroom 2: King, Ensuite BathroomBedroom 3: Double/Double Bunk, Ensuite BathroomLaundry RoomWHAT WE OFFERA STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM AMENITIESBody WashShampooConditionerHand SoapToilet PaperDish SoapDishwasher PodsLaundry DetergentPaper TowelsTrash BagsDish SpongeBath TowelsBed LinensPool TowelsWELCOME BUNDLECoffee Grounds2 Keurig PodsPopcornOlive OilFiji WaterPARKINGThere are two parking spaces in the driveway. Additional parking spaces are available by the community pool.LOCATIONHome is located in Inlet Beach, within The Preserve at Inlet Beach - A coastal community just 0.7 miles away from Inlet Beach access points and less than five minutes to the heart of Rosemary Beach. It's located directly behind the new, upscale shopping and dining center - 30Avenue, and proximity to Rosemary Beach. The home is also just a short drive to Publix grocery store.This neighborhood is a mix of full/part-time residents and vacation rentals. It's very quiet and friendly!The community features a superb outdoor pool with a pavilion, seating, and and outdoor fireplace. The community boardwalk & dock provides direct access to Powell Lake should you wish to rent paddle boards or kayaks during your stay.NEARBY BEACH ACCESSInlet Beach has several beach access options to choose from. Below are the 3 most popular:Inlet Beach Regional Beach Access: This access has parking, restrooms, and lifeguards during peak season. Located at the end of South Orange Street about 200 yards south of US Hwy 98. Inlet Beach Regional Access is the largest county access and features three dune walkovers and 117 parking spaces. Located 0.8 miles from house.Wall Street Beach Access: Located about a mile drive from the Preserve at Inlet Beach, about 200 yards east of the intersection of US30A and Highway 98, at the end of South Wall Street, where it dead ends at the gulf. NOTE: This Access has no public parking. There is no parking but there is parking, along with restrooms and outdoor showers about 1/4 mile east at the Inlet Beach Access.Winston Lane Public Beach Access: Located less than .08 away. This access is on the western border of Inlet Beach where it meets Rosemary. There is not public parking available, but plenty of bike racks if you choose to ride a bike.HOUSE RULES*Check-In: After 4PM | Check-Out: Before 10AM*Must be 25 years of age to book. Guests under 25 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian that is staying on premises.*No Smoking: Smoking is strictly prohibited including all porches.*No parties or events.*During busier times and due to limited infrastructure, internet connectivity may be affected. No refunds will be given for connection issues no wifi, or slow wifi.IMPORTANT PRIOR TO ARRIVALAll guests will be required to sign a rental agreement, as well as provide a valid ID that matches with the name of the person that made the reservation which includes: 1) a photo of your government issued ID such as a driver’s license and 2) a "selfie".Other things to note
